window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; two verifiable new stories surfaced.

stories.headline: Five-week ATF and DEA push in the Portland area nets 17 arrests and 97 firearms
stories.body: The US Attorney's Office for Oregon announced the results on 26 October. Agents recovered methamphetamine, cocaine, crack cocaine and fentanyl alongside the guns; the announcement gave no drug weights, so none is tallied.

stories.headline: Colombian Navy intercepts a fishing-style boat with 1.25 tonnes of cocaine packed in an ice chest off Chocó
stories.body: The Navy reported the stop on 26 October in the Pacific west of Chocó, with the rectangular packages hidden among fish cargo and the vessel towed to Buenaventura. Three Colombian crew members were handed to prosecutors, and the operation had support from the US JIATF South task force.
